executionPolicy.network: No external network call is part of these evidence checks
executionPolicy.browserServicePolicy: A live browser/host journey is not run here when its existing harness allocates a non-optimization port; it is recorded as blocked rather than silently using daily ports

runtimeVerification.commandPolicy: Only node scripts/<file> evidence commands are executed without a shell; not-run evidence is never executed
runtimeVerification.resultPolicy: The declared status and captured exitCode are historical metadata; a pass is valid only when the command exits 0 during this gate
runtimeVerification.outputDigest: The runner emits an output checksum set for the commands executed in the current run

statusSemantics.pass: The named focused check or static contract assertion ran with exitCode 0
statusSemantics.blocked: The API-first journey is required but cannot be exercised because task 2.1 defines a contract only; no owner API/capability is implemented
statusSemantics.not-run: A live or browser harness was intentionally not started because it would require a later owner capability or a non-optimization service port
statusSemantics.notAClaim: Legacy focused-check pass does not mean a Windows Host owner API exists
